title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei. Pd e FdI verso una legge bipartisan sulle piattaforme
snippet: A comprehensive news report on Fabio Giglietto’s research examining the impact of Meta's political content reduction filter. Analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts between 2021 and 2025, the study reveals how the algorithm drastically reduced the visibility of institutional politicians while inadvertently boosting extremist, anti-European, and pro-Russian accounts. This coverage highlights how his findings sparked discussions for bipartisan platform regulation in Italy.
description: An article detailing a research study co-authored by Fabio Giglietto on how Meta's algorithmic changes affect the organic reach of political groups in Italy.
